title: test-core-next tests stale core@next (2.2.0), older than the lock file
description: Core's publish workflow moves the next dist-tag only on prereleases, so next still points at 2.2.0 while latest is 2.4.0. self-ci.ts test-core-next installs core@next, so since 2.3.0 it has tested an older core than the lockfile. The ^2.2.0 dev range hides this; bumping it to ^2.4.0 makes npm ls fail (as it did in reporter-github#16). Fix: install the newer of core@next and core@latest, as reporter-github did in commit on feat/ldr-queued-running (self-ci.ts, test-core-next).

title: Self-CI: link commit statuses to the Tekton Dashboard
